import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX = 33;
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;

    static class Mat {
        long[][] mat = new long[MAX][MAX];

        Mat() {
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX; i++) {
                Arrays.fill(mat[i], 0);
            }
        }
    }

    static Mat matMult(Mat m1, Mat m2, int size) {
        Mat res = new Mat();
        for (int i = 0; i <= size; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= size; ++j) {
                res.mat[i][j] = 0;
                for (int p = 0; p <= size; ++p) {
                    res.mat[i][j] = (res.mat[i][j] + m1.mat[i][p] * m2.mat[p][j]) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        int k = sc.nextInt();

        Mat answer = new Mat();
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; ++i) {
            answer.mat[i][i] = 1;
        }

        List<Mat> transition = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int p = 0; p < k; p++) {
            Mat matP = new Mat();
            for (int i = 0; i <= k; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= k; ++j) {
                    matP.mat[i][j] = (i == j || i == p) ? 1 : 0;
                }
            }
            transition.add(matP);
        }

        List<Long> bits = new ArrayList<>();
        long temp = n;
        while (temp > 0) {
            bits.add(temp % k);
            temp /= k;
        }
        bits.add(0);
        // partial sum from the end
        for (int i = bits.size() - 2; i >= 0; i--) {
            bits.set(i, bits.get(i) + bits.get(i + 1));
        }

        for (int p = 0; p + 1 < bits.size(); p++) {
            int start = (int) (bits.get(p) - 1);
            int end = (int) bits.get(p + 1);
            for (int i = start; i >= end; i--) {
                answer = matMult(transition.get(i % k), answer, k);
            }

            List<Mat> pre = new ArrayList<>();
            List<Mat> suf = new ArrayList<>();
            pre.add(transition.get(0));
            for (int i = 1; i < k; i++) {
                pre.add(matMult(pre.get(i - 1), transition.get(i), k));
            }
            suf.add(transition.get(k - 1));
            for (int i = k - 2; i >= 0; i--) {
                suf.add(0, matMult(transition.get(i), suf.get(0), k));
            }
            answer = matMult(suf.get(0), answer, k);
            for (int i = 1; i < k; i++) {
                answer = matMult(suf.get(i), pre.get(i - 1), k);
            }
        }

        long total = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; ++i) {
            total += answer.mat[i][k];
        }
        System.out.println(total % MOD);
        sc.close();
    }
}
